desc:
🌙 BUILD TO THE MOON! 🧱

Aliens stole your phone and escaped to the Moon! 👽📱

Build a giant spiral tower made of bricks, earn money, and unlock powerful upgrades to build faster and higher. Can you reach the Moon, defeat the aliens, and retrieve your phone?

🧱 Build your tower
⚡ Upgrade your building speed
💰 Earn money as you climb
🌙 Reach the Moon
👽 Take your phone back from the aliens!

👍 Like and favorite the game for more updates!
